name: Target Analysis Optic
text: Once per turning point, when a friendly Pathfinder (not a drone) Shoots and you are selecting a target, a target with at least one of your Markerlight tokens counts as having one more for that action (so 4 tokens gives the Seek rule). For Blast or Torrent only the primary target is affected.

name: High-intensity Markerlight
text: Up to twice per turning point, when a friendly Pathfinder other than the MV7 Marker Drone uses Markerlight, the chosen enemy gains two tokens instead of one (up to 4).

name: Photon Grenade
text: Once per turning point, a Pathfinder with Markerlight on its datacard (not a drone) can use the PHOTON GRENADE action: pick an enemy it can see and roll a D6; on 3+ that enemy loses 2 inches of Move (never below 4) and cannot Dash until the end of its next activation.

name: Orbital Survey Uplink
text: Once per turning point, when a friendly Pathfinder uses Markerlight, it can instead give one token to any enemy operative in the killzone, seen or not. This does not combine with High-intensity Markerlight or Analyse.
